purpose: Independent re-reproduction of the SRV08B_RTO_DRILL_2026-08-27 measurement, run by a second agent from a cold checkout, to confirm the earlier figure was a real measurement rather than an unverifiable claim.

environment.server_kind: unprivileged single-user cluster (initdb + pg_ctl, no root, no Docker) via voyn-artifacts/VOYN-W0-AICC-HOSTS-LACK-DB-AND-DOCKER/pg_test_harness.sh, SCRAM auth, loopback only

dataset.description: Synthetic production-shaped dataset seeded through the aicc_app role after a full bootstrap + migrate provisioning pass (all 14 migrations applied, 55 relations incl. views), bulk-loaded with generate_series rather than row-by-row.

procedure.timed_window: target database creation (CREATE DATABASE) through the post-restore information_schema.tables count -- the wait an operator experiences during a real recovery. Excludes argument parsing and checksum verification, which precede the timer.

result.variance: 2-3s across 4 consecutive runs at this dataset size, single restore job, single backup archive reused for all 4 restores
result.conclusion: Confirms SRV08B_RTO_DRILL_2026-08-27 order of magnitude (there: 2s flat; here: 2-3s, bash's SECONDS has 1s granularity and this run sat closer to a bucket boundary). Same script, same schema, a different seeded dataset and a different, unprivileged PostgreSQL instance. The restore step is real and reproducible by a second, independent run, not just claimed by the first one.

reproduction.seed_note: Seeded with a scratch script (not checked into the repository, per the same disposition as the 2026-08-27 drill) bulk-inserting via generate_series as the aicc_app role.
reproduction.harness_note: PostgreSQL provisioned without root or Docker access via voyn-artifacts/VOYN-W0-AICC-HOSTS-LACK-DB-AND-DOCKER/pg_test_harness.sh (start/stop an unprivileged initdb+pg_ctl cluster on a high port), the same harness tests/db/conftest.py assumes via AICC_TEST_PG_ADMIN_DSN.
steps: bootstrap as the harness superuser, upgrade as aicc_migrator, grant LOGIN passwords
seed task/session/run/run_event as aicc_app via generate_series bulk inserts
